keyPoints: Do char wale rekhik samikaran ka roop ax + by + c = 0 hai — 2x + 3y = 12 iska udaharan hai.
Iske aparimit roop se kai hal hote hain — x = 0 rakhne par y = 4, x = 3 rakhne par y = 2, dono hal hain.
Hal ko kramit yugm (x, y) me likho — (0, 4), (3, 2), (6, 0) sab 2x + 3y = 12 ke hal hain.
Aalekh par ye samikaran seedhi rekha banata hai — do hal bindu milao, rekha kheench do.
x = 2 jaisa samikaran y-aksh ke samantar rekha hai; y = -3 x-aksh ke samantar rekha hai.
Vyavaharik sawalon me do agyat maano, do shartein likho — hal se dono rashiyan mil jaati hain — jaise umar ya keemat ke sawal.
Aam galti: ek hi hal ko poora samajhna — do char wale rekhik samikaran ke anant hal hote hain, ek nahi.
subject: Maths
title: Do Char Wale Rekhik Samikaran
